svg.title: Module rack — team product lines at UOC
svg.desc: 03 JOBCONNECT (FullStackAttack · Producto 4): Full-stack JavaScript job platform. Bootstrap UI → Fetch → Express · Apollo → Mongoose → MongoDB. JWT auth & roles · Socket.io real time · GraphQL API. TEAM OF 3 · UOC FP.450. 04 REPARAYA (ReparaYa · Producto 2 → 4): Repair management, rebuilt three times. P2 · PHP MVC → P3 · Laravel 12 → P4 · WordPress → MySQL 8. roles · calendar · REST JSON API · deployed to a UOC server. TEAM OF 3 · UOC FP.448. 05 ONLINE STORE (BugBusters · Producto 5): Java desktop store management. JavaFX · FXML → controllers → JPA · Hibernate → MySQL. KPI dashboard · Maven · grew from a console app with JUnit tests. TEAM OF 4 · UOC FP.447.
svg.text: + JWT auth & roles · Socket.io real time · GraphQL API
+ roles · calendar · REST JSON API · deployed to a UOC server
+ KPI dashboard · Maven · grew from a console app with JUnit tests
